title: odd-one-time-code
description: A one-time code (a verification code sent by text message or email) entered into `maxlength` cells (default six). It is one native input with `autocomplete="one-time-code"` and a numeric keyboard (the global `inputmode` attribute, `numeric` unless the host sets it) behind the drawn cells, so the platform's autofill, paste, and form value work as on any field: digits only, typed or pasted, the caret always after the last digit. `status` reports the verification the page runs: `pending` keeps the code read-only with a busy line, `complete` confirms it; a failure is `error`.

name.description: Name submitted with the form. Reflected: a form-associated element submits under its name attribute.

error.description: Error message; marks the field invalid (custom validity) while set.

value.description: Initial value; the `value` attribute, as on native inputs.

placeholder.description: Placeholder; never a substitute for a label.

autocomplete.description: Autofill hint for the native field.

required.description: A value is required to submit.

status.description: The verification the page runs: `pending` makes the code read-only and shows `strings.pending`; `complete` shows `strings.complete`.

strings.description: Localized string overrides: `hint` (under the cells while idle), `pending`, `complete`.

value.description: The current value. Setting it (or typing) detaches it from `defaultValue`.
